# Apps by Gerrit Schimpf

> Focused Android apps by Gerrit Schimpf that each do one job well. Every app and guide below has a Markdown page with all it says on the web.

Website: https://apps.schimpf.es/
Sitemap: https://apps.schimpf.es/sitemap.xml

## Apps

- [Alarm Clock: Wake-Up Missions](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/index.md): Reliable alarms for heavy sleepers. Solve a task to switch the alarm off.
- [Allotment Club Ledger](https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/index.md): Rent, dues, meters and receipts for allotment club treasurers
- [Anti-Bucket List: No Journal](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/index.md): Write down what you said no to and check later if you're still glad.
- [Binaural Beats](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/index.md): Binaural and isochronic beats to relax, focus or sleep.
- [Boat Trailer Tongue Weight](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/index.md): Check tongue weight, axle loads and tow ratings of your boat trailer rig.
- [Der Monarch](https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/index.md): Turn-based economic strategy in 1720s Germany: rise from reeve to emperor.
- [Dyslexia Reader: Book Reader](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/index.md): Read books with dyslexia-friendly fonts, a line ruler and read aloud.
- [Field Forms: Job Sheets & PDFs](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-trades-field-forms/index.md): Job sheets, checklists, quotes and invoices with photos and signatures as PDFs
- [GLP Mate: GLP-1 Shot Tracker](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/index.md): Private diary for GLP-1 shots, side effects, weight, food and supply.
- [Grief Letter Journal](https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/index.md): Write unsent letters to someone you lost. Private and encrypted on your phone.
- [Health Reports: BP & Sleep PDF](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/index.md): Turn Health Connect blood pressure, heart rate and sleep into a PDF report.
- [Hipoteca: Mortgage Calculator](https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/index.md): Plan, compare and track a Spanish mortgage: costs, taxes and Euríbor risk.
- [Hive Log: Beekeeping Journal](https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/index.md): Log hive inspections, treatments and feedings, track varroa, set reminders.
- [Horse Care Log: Farrier & Vet](https://apps.schimpf.es/horse-care-log/index.md): Horse care log: farrier, vaccines, worming, vet notes, costs, reminders.
- [Job Loss Plan: 12-Week Guide](https://apps.schimpf.es/job-loss-12-week-plan/index.md): Laid off? A calm 12-week checklist with deadlines, budget and runway math.
- [Metronome & Practice Log](https://apps.schimpf.es/metronome-and-practice-log/index.md): Metronome that logs your practice time automatically and tracks your streak
- [Minijob Calculator Germany](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-german-minijob-calculator/index.md): German Minijob limit, hours and employer cost 2026/2027. No account.
- [Numeric IBS Symptom Scorer](https://apps.schimpf.es/numeric-ibs-symptom-scorer/index.md): Rate IBS symptoms 0-10, log bowel movements and food, spot possible triggers.
- [Paint Calc: Room Paint Amount](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/index.md): Work out how much paint a room needs, with coats, doors and waste
- [PDF Reader & Scanner](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/index.md): Read, search, scan and sign PDFs on your phone.
- [Plumber Invoice & Quote Maker](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/index.md): Plumbing quotes, signatures, invoices and payments for plumbers
- [Steak Doneness Chart & Timer](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-steak-doneness-chart/index.md): Pull temps for steak, pork, chicken, lamb and fish, with a rest and flip timer.
- [Storage Analyzer: Big Files](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/index.md): Find large files, duplicates and old junk, then clear space safely.
- [Stutter Practice: DAF](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/index.md): DAF, paced speech and easy onset practice for people who stutter.
- [TDS Section Calc India](https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/index.md): Calculate TDS by section with 1961 and 2025 Act numbers and due dates.

# Alarm Clock: Wake-Up Missions

> Reliable alarms for heavy sleepers. Solve a task to switch the alarm off.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.alarmclock&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/privacy/
- Tools
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/es/index.md

## About

Alarm Clock is made for people who sleep through normal alarms. It rings on the minute, gets louder step by step, and asks you to finish a short task before it lets you turn it off.

## Features

### Alarms

- Set as many alarms as you like, once or on chosen weekdays
- Add a label to each alarm
- Skip only the next ring of a repeating alarm
- Alarms are set again after a reboot and after a time or time zone change
- The alarm uses the alarm volume, so it also rings when the phone is on silent

### Wake-up missions

Pick one mission per alarm. You cannot skip it.

If a mission fails three times, the app offers an easier math problem so you are never stuck. If you leave the mission, the alarm rings again after one minute.

- Math: three difficulty levels, and you choose how many problems
- Shake: shake the phone as many times as you set
- QR code or barcode: scan a code you stuck somewhere you have to walk to, such as the bathroom
- Steps: walk the number of steps you set

### Snooze

Snooze is always available on the ringing screen. Set the interval from 1 to 30 minutes and the maximum number of snoozes from 0 to 10, or unlimited. Once a mission has started, snoozing is no longer possible.

### Sound and alerts

- Bundled tones, system ringtones, or your own audio file
- If your file is moved or deleted, a bundled tone rings instead, never silence
- Volume ramps up over a time you choose
- Vibration on or off for each alarm
- Optional flashlight strobe, off by default, with a photosensitivity warning before you can turn it on

### Reliability

Phones often stop apps to save battery. A setup guide walks you through the exact alarm, notification, full-screen and battery settings. It includes guides for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OnePlus, Oppo, Vivo and Realme, and a self-test alarm that rings one minute later.

### Extras

- Widget that shows your next alarm with a countdown
- Light and dark theme that follow your system
- Works on phones and tablets
- Labels for screen readers and large touch targets
- English and German

### Privacy

The app has no internet permission, no account and no analytics. Your alarms stay on your phone. Camera access is used only to scan a QR code for the QR mission. Activity recognition is used only to count steps for the steps mission. Both are requested only when you need them.

All features are available in the app. It has no in-app purchases.

### Open source

Alarm Clock is open source under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

Questions or feedback: apps@schimpf.es

## Guides

- [Alarm Not Going Off on Android: Causes and Fixes](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/alarm-not-going-off-android/index.md): Why an Android alarm stays silent or rings late, and a checklist of settings to fix it, from exact alarms to battery limits.
- [Math Alarm Problems: Easy, Medium and Hard Examples](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/math-alarm-problems-examples/index.md): See what easy, medium and hard math alarm problems look like, how they are built, and how to pick a level that wakes you up.
- [Snooze Time Calculator: How Late Will You Wake Up?](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/snooze-time-calculator/index.md): Work out how many minutes snoozing costs you and when the last alarm rings. Includes a calculator and a worked example.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It rings on the exact minute, raises the volume over a time you set (0 to 120 seconds) and asks for a mission before you can switch it off: math, shake, QR code or barcode, or steps. Snooze is available until the mission starts.

### Where is my data stored?

Only on your phone, in a local database. The app has no internet permission, no account and no analytics, so nothing is sent anywhere.

### Does it cost anything?

On Google Play you pay once when you install it. It is free on F-Droid and GitHub. There are no ads and no in-app purchases, and all features are included.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer, on phones and tablets. On Android 12 and 12L you may need to allow exact alarms in the app's special access settings.

### Can I skip the mission if I cannot solve it?

No. After 3 failed attempts the app offers an easy math problem so you are never stuck. If you leave the mission, the alarm rings again after one minute.

### Which languages does the app use?

English and German. The app follows your system language.

# Allotment Club Ledger

> Rent, dues, meters and receipts for allotment club treasurers

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.germanallotmentclubledger&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/privacy/
- Finance
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/es/index.md

## About

The cash book for a German allotment club (Kleingartenverein), on your phone. No account and no spreadsheets.

Allotment Club Ledger is made for the treasurer (Kassenwart) who tracks plot rent, dues and levies in Excel or on paper. It calculates the yearly charges, creates the invoices and produces what the cash audit (Kassenprüfung) needs.

## Features

### Plots and members

- Plots with size in square metres and tenant history.
- Tenant change in the middle of the year: all charges are split by month.
- Members with or without a plot, with contact details and balance.

### Yearly charges

- Rent per square metre or flat per plot, membership dues and levies.
- Water and electricity by meter reading, with an optional base fee. Fast plot-by-plot entry, with a warning for readings that look wrong.
- Community work hours: required hours, hours worked and a fee for each missing hour.
- Invoice as PDF with IBAN and payment reference, shared by mail or messenger.

### Bookings and receipts

- Bank account and cash box, each with its own balance, and transfers between them.
- Income and expenses by category. Payments are matched to open charges automatically, partial payments included.
- Photograph a receipt or attach a file. The app points out bookings without a receipt.
- Open items: who has not paid, or paid only in part.

### Cash audit

- Report as PDF and CSV: opening balance, income and expenses by category, closing balance per account, and every booking with its receipt reference.
- Close the fiscal year so that nothing changes afterwards. You can reopen it if a correction is needed.

### Privacy and security

- The app has no internet permission. Your data is not sent anywhere.
- Database and receipts are encrypted on the device.
- App lock with fingerprint or device PIN. On Android 13 and newer the recent-apps preview stays blank.
- Password-protected, encrypted backup to a file you choose. Restore from the same file.

### Widget

- Open amount, number of unpaid members and account balances on your home screen. Amounts can be hidden.

### Plot limit and pro

Light and dark theme follow the system setting. Large buttons and TalkBack support. The app is available in German and English. Invoices and reports are always created in German.

- All features work for clubs with up to 15 plots.
- Adding more than 15 plots needs Pro, an optional one-time in-app purchase through Google Play. Everything else is included without it.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It is a cash book for the treasurer (Kassenwart) of an allotment club. It calculates rent, dues, levies, water and electricity, and community work fees, creates one invoice PDF per tenant, and exports the cash audit report as PDF and CSV.

### What does it not do?

It does not sync between devices, send reminder letters, create SEPA direct debit files or connect to a bank. It manages one club per install, and members and auditors do not use it.

### Where is my data stored?

Only on your device. The app has no internet permission, and the database and receipts are encrypted. You can save a password-protected backup to a file you choose.

### Is anything paid?

No. All features work for up to 15 plots. A club with more plots needs the optional one-time Pro purchase through Google Play. There are no ads and no subscription.

### Which Android versions work?

Android 11 and newer. On Android 13 and newer the recent-apps preview stays blank.

### Which language do the app and the invoices use?

The app is available in German and English. Invoices and reports are always created in German.

# Anti-Bucket List: No Journal

> Write down what you said no to and check later if you're still glad.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.antibucketlist&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/privacy/
- Productivity
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/es/index.md

## About

Every "no" protects a "yes". Anti-Bucket List is a private journal for your deliberate declines: the invitation you turned down, the upgrade you skipped, the extra project you didn't take on. Write down what you said no to and why, then check back later to see if you are still glad you did.

## Features

### Write it down in seconds

- What you declined and why, in your own words
- Reason tags: Time, Money, Energy, Values and Boundaries, plus tags of your own
- How saying no felt, on a scale from relieved to uneasy
- The date you decided
- Optional money saved and hours saved

### "Still glad?" check-ins

After 30 and 90 days, a reminder asks how you feel now: still glad, unsure, or regret it. Add a short note if you like. Over time you see which kinds of no serve you well. If notifications are off, due check-ins also show at the top of your journal.

### Your journal

- Search the titles and reasons you wrote
- Filter by tag
- Filter by check-in result: pending, due, glad, unsure or regret
- Open any entry to see its full reason and its check-in history

### Stats

- Total no's, money saved and hours saved
- No's per tag
- Your check-in results as glad, unsure and regret

### Home-screen widget

See this month's no's and what you saved, and add a new entry with one tap.

### Backup and restore

Save your journal to a JSON file in a place you choose, and restore it later. The file is not encrypted, and the app warns you before every backup.

### Private by design

- No account and no sign-up
- No analytics and no advertising
- The app has no internet permission. Your journal stays on your phone.
- Excluded from Android cloud backup and device transfer

### Pro features

Everything described above works without a purchase and has no limits. Pro is an optional one-time purchase through Google Play, not a subscription. It adds:

Made for people working on boundaries, minimalism or better decisions, and for anyone who wants a record that saying no was the right call.

Works on phones and tablets, in light and dark mode, with screen reader support.

- App lock with fingerprint, face or device PIN. It also hides the widget numbers and notification text.
- Advanced stats: no's per month for the last 12 months, regret rate per tag, and money and hours saved per tag
- CSV export for spreadsheets

## Screenshots

- [Journal](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/screen-1.png)
- [Entry detail](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/screen-2.png)
- [Stats](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/screen-3.png)
- [New entry form](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/screen-4.png)
- [Settings](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/screen-5.png)

## Guides

- [How to Keep a Journal of Things You Said No To](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/how-to-keep-a-decision-journal-of-no/index.md): A step-by-step way to record what you declined, why it felt that way, and when to review it. Includes a 30 and 90 day check-in schedule.
- [Regret Rate Calculator: How Often Do You Regret No?](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/regret-rate-calculator/index.md): Work out your regret rate for the things you declined. Formula, a worked example and a small calculator you can use right here.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It is a journal of the things you said no to. You write what you declined and why, add tags and how it felt, and after 30 and 90 days it asks "Still glad?".

### Does it need an account or internet?

No. There is no account, no analytics and no ads, and the app has no internet permission.

### Where is my data stored?

Only on your phone. The journal is excluded from Android cloud backup and device transfer. You can save it to a JSON file you choose and restore it later, but that file is not encrypted.

### What needs a purchase?

Entries, tags, check-ins, search, basic stats, the widget and backup are free and have no limits. Pro is an optional one-time purchase through Google Play, not a subscription. It adds app lock, CSV export and advanced stats.

### Which Android versions does it support?

Android 8.0 or newer. It works on phones and tablets, in light and dark mode.

### Can I move my journal to a new phone?

Yes, with a backup. Save a JSON file on the old phone, copy it over, and restore it in Settings on the new one.

# Binaural Beats

> Binaural and isochronic beats to relax, focus or sleep.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.binauralbeats&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/privacy/
- Music & Audio
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/es/index.md

## About

Binaural Beats creates soft beat tones live on your phone. Pick a starting preset, adjust it to your taste and let it play in the background while you relax, meditate, work or fall asleep.

Four ways to hear a beat • Binaural: each ear gets a slightly different tone, and you hear the difference as a gentle pulse. Use headphones. • Monaural: both tones are mixed into both ears. Works on speakers too. • Isochronic: one tone that softly pulses on and off. • Bilateral: one tone moves calmly back and forth between your left and right ear. Switching modes crossfades smoothly, without clicks.

Shape the sound • Beat from 0.25 to 45 Hz, with a live label for the band (Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma). • Carrier tone from 100 to 1000 Hz. • Optional white, pink or brown noise, with its own volume. • Sine or soft square pulse for isochronic and bilateral mode.

Sessions that fade gently Choose 5 to 90 minutes or no limit. Every session fades in, fades out at the end, and pause, resume and stop fade softly too.

Journeys Build a session from steps that hold a beat or glide it slowly to another one, for example from 12 Hz down to 3 Hz to wind down in the evening. A chart shows how the beat changes over time.

Presets Eight starting points are included: Deep Sleep, Nap, Relax, Meditation, Calm Focus, Active Focus, Gamma Attention and Wind Down. Save your own versions, duplicate, rename and delete them, and import or export them as a file.

Plays in the background Playback keeps going with the screen off, with controls in the notification and on the lock screen. A home-screen widget shows the current preset with a play button. The app does not pause other audio, so you can play beats quietly under your music or a podcast.

Export as audio Save a session as a WAV file to play it anywhere.

Honest about the evidence The About page sums up the research in plain words: effects are modest and mixed, with the clearest results for short-term relaxation. This app is a relaxation tool, not a medical device. Before the first play it shows a short safety note about volume, driving and medical conditions.

Private by design No account, no ads, no tracking and no internet access. Your presets and settings stay on your device.

Also: light and dark theme, a reduce motion option, and English, German and Spanish.

## Screenshots

- [Player running](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/screen-1.png)
- [Presets list](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/screen-2.png)
- [Wind Down journey](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/screen-3.png)
- [Deep Sleep tune sheet](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/screen-4.png)
- [Gamma Attention player](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/screen-5.png)
- [About](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/screen-6.png)

## Guides

- [Binaural Beat Frequency Calculator and Formula](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/binaural-beat-frequency-calculator/index.md): Work out the left and right tone for any binaural beat with one formula, a worked example and a small calculator. Includes how a beat glides over time.
- [Brainwave Frequency Chart: Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/brainwave-frequency-chart/index.md): A chart of the five brainwave bands in Hz, what each is usually linked to, and which beat rates to use when you listen to binaural beats.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It generates binaural, monaural, isochronic and bilateral beats live on your phone, with a beat from 0.25 to 45 Hz and a carrier from 100 to 1000 Hz. It plays sessions of 5 to 90 minutes or without a limit, and it can save a session as a WAV file.

### Does it treat or diagnose anything?

No. It is a relaxation tool and not a medical device. The About page says the research effects are modest and mixed, and a safety note about volume, driving, epilepsy and pacemakers appears before the first play.

### Where is my data stored?

Your presets and settings stay in the app's storage on your device. The app has no account, no ads, no tracking and no internet permission, so nothing leaves the phone.

### Do I need headphones?

Binaural mode needs headphones, because each ear must hear its own tone. Monaural and isochronic modes also work on speakers.

### Does it keep playing with the screen off?

Yes. A background service keeps playing with notification and lock-screen controls. The app does not pause other audio, so you can play beats quietly under music or a podcast.

### Does it need a purchase, and which Android versions work?

The app is meant to be bought once on Google Play. It has no ads, no in-app purchases and no account. It runs on Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer.

# Boat Trailer Tongue Weight

> Check tongue weight, axle loads and tow ratings of your boat trailer rig.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.offlineboattrailertongueweight&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/privacy/
- Auto &Amp; Vehicles
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/es/index.md

## About

Check that your boat trailer is loaded right before you leave the ramp.

Boat Trailer Tongue Weight treats your tow vehicle, trailer and boat as one rig. Enter the ratings from your door sticker, hitch label and trailer VIN plate, add what sits on the trailer, and see at a glance whether the rig passes. Everything runs on your phone. The app has no internet permission and needs no account.

## Features

### What it checks

Each check shows Pass, Warn or Fail. The dry trailer and the loaded trailer are shown side by side, so you see what fuel, water and gear change.

- Tongue weight in percent, with 7 to 10 percent as the target
- Hitch and receiver maximum tongue weight
- Trailer axle load and trailer GVWR
- Tow rating, payload, vehicle GVWR and GCWR
- Rear axle load (GAWR), when you enter wheelbase and hitch overhang

### Built for the ramp

- Single-axle and tandem-axle trailers
- Load items with weight and position: hull, engine, fuel, livewell or ballast water, gear
- Fuel and water tanks with a level slider. The weight follows from tank size and level.
- Presets for outboard engines from 2.5 to 350 HP and for common gear
- Hints for reaching 7 to 10 percent: drain the livewell, move the boat forward on the trailer, move gear or move the axle
- Unlimited saved rigs. Edit, duplicate or delete any rig from the list.
- PDF summary of a rig to save or share
- Home screen widget for your last-used rig
- Imperial or metric units
- Light and dark theme, phone and tablet layouts, screen reader labels and large touch targets

### How the tongue weight is found

The app estimates tongue weight from the weight and position of each item relative to the axle. It does not measure anything. The results are only as good as the weights and distances you enter.

### Privacy

The app has no internet permission, no account, no ads and no analytics. Your rigs stay on your phone and are not included in cloud backup. A PDF leaves the phone only when you share or save it.

### Purchase

The app is a paid download. Every feature is included after that: unlimited rigs, all presets, PDF export and the widget. There are no in-app purchases and no subscription.

### Safety

This app estimates loads from the numbers you enter. It is a planning aid, not a certified scale. Always follow the ratings of your vehicle, hitch and trailer, and weigh your rig on a certified scale when in doubt. You are responsible for a safe and legal tow.

- [Rig list](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/screen-3.png)

## Guides

- [Boat Fuel and Water Weight per Gallon Chart](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/boat-fuel-and-water-weight-per-gallon/index.md): How much gasoline, diesel and water weigh per gallon, with a chart by tank size and a worked example of how they change trailer tongue weight.
- [Boat Trailer Tongue Weight Calculator and Formula](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/boat-trailer-tongue-weight-calculator/index.md): Estimate boat trailer tongue weight from item weights and positions. Formula, worked example, the 7 to 10 percent target and a small calculator.
- [How to Increase Boat Trailer Tongue Weight](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/how-to-increase-boat-trailer-tongue-weight/index.md): Four ways to fix low boat trailer tongue weight, with formulas and a worked example. The same math works in reverse for a heavy tongue.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It checks a rig of tow vehicle, trailer and boat for tongue weight (target 7 to 10 percent), hitch and receiver rating, trailer axle load, trailer GVWR, tow rating, payload, vehicle GVWR, GCWR and rear axle load. Each check shows Pass, Warn or Fail, for the dry and the loaded trailer side by side.

### Does it weigh my trailer?

No. It estimates tongue weight from the weight and position of each item relative to the axle, so the result is only as good as the numbers you enter. It does not connect to scales or sensors and is not a certified scale.

### Where does my data stay?

On your phone. The app has no internet permission, no account, no ads and no analytics, and your rigs are not included in cloud backup. A PDF summary leaves the phone only when you share or save it.

### Do I have to pay for features after the purchase?

No. The app is a paid download, and unlimited rigs, all presets, PDF export and the home screen widget are included. There are no in-app purchases and no subscription.

### Which Android versions and devices work?

Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer, on phones and tablets. It follows the light or dark theme of your system.

### Does it work in metric units and other languages?

Yes for units: a setting switches between lb, in and gal and kg, cm and liters. The app screens are in English only.

# Der Monarch

> Turn-based economic strategy in 1720s Germany: rise from reeve to emperor.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.dermonarch&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/privacy/
- Strategy
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/es/index.md

## About

Der Monarch is a turn-based economic strategy game set in the 18th century. It is Anno 1720 and you rule a small German realm as a humble Landvogt (reeve). By 1760 you want to wear the emperor's crown.

Please note: the game is in German only.

Every year has nine steps: - Read the year report: harvest, money, people, events and battles. - Feed your people. Too little grain and they starve or leave. Plenty draws settlers from abroad. - Plant your fields with potatoes, grain and oats, or let land lie fallow so the soil recovers. - Set customs, sales and income tax, and choose how harsh your courts are. - Buy and sell grain and land at this year's prices. - Build markets, mills, palace wings, cathedral parts, or raise new companies of soldiers. - March against a neutral neighbour or a rival ruler, or keep the peace. - Send ships on sea routes from the North Sea to China. Some come home rich with gold, grain or settlers. Some never return. - End the year and see what your orders brought.

Climb the ranks from Landvogt to Baron, Graf, Fürst, Herzog, König and finally Kaiser. Each rank needs enough people, land, palace, cathedral and markets. But time is short: your ruler ages, and from 60 on every year could be the last.

Play alone or with up to four rulers on one device, passing the phone in turn. Brandenburg, Bayern, Sachsen and Württemberg compete for the crown. A handoff screen keeps each turn private, and a standings table shows who leads.

Three difficulty levels change how good harvests are and how much grain the rats eat.

Also included: - Automatic save after every move; resume any time. - Hand-drawn illustrations and 8-bit sound effects, with a mute switch. - Light and dark design that follows your system setting. - Works on phones and tablets. - Home screen widget showing whose turn it is, the year, rank, gold and people.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no internet access, no data collection. Your game stays on your device.

## Guides

- [Der Monarch feeding and harvest guide with formulas](https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/der-monarch-feeding-and-harvest-guide/index.md): How much grain your people need in Der Monarch, how crops and soil set the harvest, and how feeding changes population. With worked examples.
- [Der Monarch ranks and what each rank needs](https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/der-monarch-rank-requirements/index.md): Table of every rank in Der Monarch, from Landvogt to Kaiser, with the people, land, palace, cathedral and markets each one needs.

## Questions and answers

### What is Der Monarch?

A turn-based economic strategy game set between 1720 and 1760. You feed your people, farm, tax, trade, build, wage war and send ships to rise from Landvogt to Kaiser.

### Is the game available in English?

No. All text in the game is German, and the game content (crops, ranks, events, sea routes) is written in German too. The guides on this site explain the terms and numbers.

### Which Android versions does it run on?

Android 8.0 and newer, on phones and tablets. It follows the light or dark setting of your system.

### Does it need internet or an account, and where is my game stored?

It needs neither. The app has no network access, no account, no analytics and asks for no permissions. Your game is saved on your device after every move and is not part of Android cloud backup, so it does not move to a new phone.

### Do I have to buy anything?

No. The game has no ads, no in-app purchases and no billing code.

### Can I play with other people?

Yes, with up to four rulers on one device, passing it around in turn. There is no online multiplayer, and there is one save slot.

# Dyslexia Reader: Book Reader

> Read books with dyslexia-friendly fonts, a line ruler and read aloud.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.dyslexiareaderandroid&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/privacy/
- Books &Amp; Reference
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/es/index.md

## About

Dyslexia Reader is a book reader made for people with dyslexia. Import your own books, then set up the text so it is comfortable for your eyes.

## Features

### Reading tools

- Line focus ruler: dims the lines around the one you are reading, so you keep your place.
- Dyslexia-friendly fonts: Lexend, OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible.
- Letter, word and line spacing sliders, plus text size.
- Reading presets for background colour, text colour, font and spacing.
- Read aloud with the voice installed on your device. The current sentence is highlighted and you can change the speed. Reading can continue with the screen off.
- Light and dark mode follow your system setting.

### Your books

- Import TXT, EPUB and PDF files from your device.
- Share plain text from another app to add it to your library.
- PDF files are turned into text, so your font and spacing apply. Images and page layout are not kept. Scanned PDFs without text are not supported.
- A short sample book is included, so you can try every feature before adding your own books.
- Your library shows progress and time left for each book. A home-screen widget shows your reading progress and takes you back to your place.

### Made to be accessible

- Large touch targets and labels for screen readers.
- Works on phones and tablets.

### Privacy

- No account is needed.
- Your books and settings stay on your device. The app has no internet permission, no ads and no analytics.
- You can delete a single book or all app data at any time in Settings.
- An option in Settings blocks screenshots.

### Free and paid features

Free: TXT and EPUB import, shared text, the Lexend font, the basic line focus ruler, spacing sliders and the widget. Unlock with one purchase through Google Play: all fonts, read aloud with sentence highlight, reading presets, a customisable ruler (height, dimming and tint) and PDF import. The purchase is made once, needs no account, and can be restored with the same Google account.

Fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License. Licence details are in Settings.

Questions or feedback: apps@schimpf.es

## Guides

- [Dyslexia-Friendly Fonts Compared and How to Set Them Up](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/dyslexia-friendly-fonts-compared/index.md): Lexend, OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible compared, with research notes and starting values for font size and letter, word and line spacing.
- [How to Read a PDF in a Dyslexia-Friendly Font on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/read-pdf-with-dyslexia-font/index.md): PDFs lock the font and layout. Here is how to turn a text PDF into reflowable text on Android and what limits apply.
- [Reading Time Calculator: How Long to Read a Book](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/reading-time-calculator/index.md): Work out how long a book takes to read from its word or character count. Formula, worked examples and a small calculator.

## Questions and answers

### What does Dyslexia Reader do?

It reads TXT, EPUB and PDF files and plain text shared from other apps. You choose a dyslexia-friendly font (Lexend, OpenDyslexic or Atkinson Hyperlegible), set letter, word and line spacing, use a line focus ruler, and listen with read aloud that highlights the current sentence.

### What does it not do?

It does not do OCR, so scanned PDFs without text are not supported. PDFs are turned into plain text, so images and page layout are not kept. It does not highlight single words while reading aloud.

### Where are my books and settings stored?

Only on your device. The app has no internet permission, no account, no ads and no analytics, and backup is switched off. You can delete one book or all app data in Settings.

### What is free and what needs the purchase?

TXT and EPUB import, shared text, the Lexend font, the basic ruler, spacing sliders and the widget are free. The other fonts, read aloud, reading presets, the adjustable ruler and PDF import need one purchase through Google Play. It needs no account and can be restored with the same Google account.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 10 or newer. It runs on phones and tablets.

### Can I try it before buying?

Yes. A short sample book is included, and you can add it from the empty Library. It lets you try the features before you add your own books.

# Field Forms: Job Sheets & PDFs

> Job sheets, checklists, quotes and invoices with photos and signatures as PDFs

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-trades-field-forms/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.offlinetradesfieldforms&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-trades-field-forms/privacy/
- Business
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-trades-field-forms/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-trades-field-forms/es/index.md

## About

Field Forms is the paperwork app for solo tradespeople and small crews: electricians, plumbers, heating engineers and general builders. Fill in job forms, take photos, get the client's signature and send a clean PDF from your phone. It works without signal and without an account.

## Features

### Jobs and forms

- Jobs with a client, a site address, and as many documents and photos as you need
- Job sheets, service reports and inspection checklists (pass, fail or N/A, plus your own items)
- A job can hold several forms of the same kind
- Mark a job done to move it to the archive, and search by title, client, address or document number

### Quotes and invoices

- Line items with quantity and unit price, tax rate and totals
- Discounts and deposits as negative lines
- Automatic numbering such as QUO-0001 and INV-0001, with prefixes you choose
- A quote signed by the client counts as accepted and converts to an invoice in one tap
- Due dates, paid and unpaid tracking, and an overdue marker

### Photos and signatures

- Add photos from your camera app or gallery, with captions
- Photos are resized, and location and camera details are removed
- The client signs on the screen
- Save your own signature once and reuse it

### Pdf and sharing

- Your business name, address, phone, email and tax ID on every document
- Photos with captions and times added to job sheets, reports and checklists
- A4 or Letter page size
- Share by email, WhatsApp or SMS from the share sheet. The client's email is filled in for you.
- Signed or shared documents become read-only. Duplicate one to make changes.

### Clients

- A reusable client list with call, email and map shortcuts
- Erase a client together with all their jobs, documents and photos in one step

### Privacy and backup

- No account, no server and no analytics. Your data stays on your phone.
- Optional PIN or fingerprint lock
- Export a backup to Files or Google Drive, with optional AES-256 password protection, and restore it later

### Home screen widget

Shows your unpaid and overdue invoice totals and a button to start a new job. Amounts are hidden while the app lock is on.

### Phones and tablets

Large buttons for use on site. On a tablet, the job list and job details sit side by side. Light and dark themes follow your phone's setting. The app is in English.

### Pro upgrade

All features work without paying, except two. PDFs made without Pro carry a small watermark, and adding your logo to PDFs needs Pro. Pro is a one-time in-app purchase through Google Play and can be restored on the same Google account.

The forms are general-purpose job records. They are not certified forms such as gas safety records or electrical installation condition reports.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It handles the paperwork for a job: job sheets, service reports, inspection checklists, quotes and invoices, with photos and client signatures, shared as PDF. It also tracks due dates and shows an overdue marker on unpaid invoices.

### What does it not do?

It has no certified forms such as gas safety records or electrical installation condition reports, no cloud sync, no payment processing and no scheduling. The app is in English only.

### Where is my data stored?

On your phone only. There is no account, no server and no analytics. You can export a backup through the Android file picker (for example to Google Drive), with an optional AES-256 password.

### Does it work without internet?

Yes. Creating jobs, forms, photos, signatures and PDFs works without signal. You only need a connection to send a PDF by email or WhatsApp, or to buy Pro.

### Do I have to pay for anything?

Every feature works for free. PDFs made without Pro carry a watermark, and adding your logo to PDFs needs Pro. Pro is a one-time in-app purchase through Google Play and can be restored on the same Google account.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 8.0 (API level 26) and newer, on phones and tablets.

# GLP Mate: GLP-1 Shot Tracker

> Private diary for GLP-1 shots, side effects, weight, food and supply.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.glp1&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/privacy/
- Health & Fitness
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/es/index.md

## About

GLP Mate is a private diary for people on GLP-1 medication such as semaglutide, tirzepatide or liraglutide, whether you use pens, pills or compounded vials. Everything you enter stays on your phone in an encrypted database. No account, no ads, no tracking.

## Features

### Shots and doses

Set up one or more medications, each with its own schedule: weekly, daily or every few days, at the time you choose. Log each dose with time, amount in mg, injection site, pain, lot number and a note. The app suggests the next injection site from your own rotation order. A dose plan can be pre-filled from the product label, and you confirm or change it. GLP Mate never recommends a dose.

### Reminders

Get a reminder when a shot is due, with buttons to log it or snooze. Optional evening check-in, water and supply reminders. Reminder texts are discreet and never show on the lock screen.

### Daily check-in

Rate food noise from 0 to 10, plus hunger, fullness, mood, energy, sleep and bowel movement if you like. Track 13 common side effects or add your own, as mild, moderate or severe. If you log severe vomiting or severe belly pain, the app shows a clear card to contact a doctor.

### Body

Log weight with a 7-day average, body measurements, BMI and a goal range.

### Food and water

Log meals with optional protein, fiber and calories, re-log favourite meals with one tap, and set daily targets for protein, fiber, water and steps.

### Supply

Track each pen, vial or pack. Logged doses are taken off the item in use, and you get one alert when you run low or an item is close to its use-by date.

### Today and insights

Today shows your next shot, a daily checklist and what is coming up. Insights shows your weight over up to 3 months with dose changes. Every chart can also be shown as a table. Badges reward consistent logging, never weight lost.

### Health connect

Optionally read weight, body fat, lean mass and steps from Health Connect, and save the weights and water you enter there.

### For your doctor

Create a clear PDF report for any date range and share it however you like, or export all entries as CSV.

### Privacy and backup

The database key is protected by the Android Keystore. An optional app lock uses your fingerprint, face or screen lock. Make an encrypted backup file with your own password, back up weekly to a folder you choose, or nightly to a hidden app folder in your own Google Drive, encrypted on your phone first. No analytics, nothing sent to the developer, and one button deletes all data.

### Premium (OPTIONAL, ONE-TIME PURCHASE)

All logging, reminders, backups and the basic doctor report are free. A single in-app purchase, with no subscription, adds: an estimated medication level per compound, food noise and hunger by days since your shot, a side-effect heatmap, weight charts over 6 months and all time, encrypted progress photos with side-by-side compare, and extra report pages.

Available in English, German and Spanish, with metric or imperial units.

GLP Mate is a personal diary, not a medical device. It does not give medical advice, make diagnoses or recommend doses. Estimates and charts are for information only. Always follow your prescriber and the leaflet that comes with your medication.

- [Dose log](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/screen-2.png)
- [Daily check-in](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/screen-3.png)
- [Weight log](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/screen-4.png)

## Guides

- [BMI Calculator and Chart: Formula in kg/cm and lb/in](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/bmi-calculator-kg-cm-lb-in/index.md): How to calculate BMI in kg and cm or lb and inches, with the WHO category chart, a worked example and a calculator. For adults only.
- [Semaglutide, Tirzepatide and Liraglutide Half-Life Chart](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/semaglutide-tirzepatide-half-life-chart/index.md): Half-life of semaglutide, tirzepatide and liraglutide, with a decay table, the formula and a worked example of how much is left days after a dose.

## Questions and answers

### What does GLP Mate do?

It is a diary for GLP-1 medication. You log doses with injection site and pain, daily check-ins with food noise and side effects, weight, meals and your supply of pens or vials, and you get discreet reminders when a shot is due.

### Does it tell me which dose to take?

No. The app never recommends a dose, gives medical advice or makes a diagnosis. A dose plan can be pre-filled from the product label, and you confirm or change it. The medication level chart is labeled as an estimate.

### Where is my data stored?

On your phone, in an encrypted database. There are no analytics and nothing is sent to the developer. The only network use is the optional backup to a hidden folder in your own Google Drive, encrypted on your phone first.

### Do I need an account, and is there advertising?

No account is needed and the app has no ads. You can also back up to a file or a folder on your phone, protected with your own password.

### What is free and what needs a purchase?

Logging, reminders, check-ins, supply, weight charts up to 3 months, the basic PDF report for your doctor, CSV export and backups are free. A one-time purchase, with no subscription, adds the estimated medication level, more insight cards, weight charts over longer periods, progress photos and extra report pages.

### Which Android versions does it support?

Android 9 or newer. The app is available in English, German and Spanish, with metric or imperial units.

# Grief Letter Journal

> Write unsent letters to someone you lost. Private and encrypted on your phone.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.griefletterjournal&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/privacy/
- Lifestyle
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/es/index.md

## About

Write the letters you didn't get to send.

Grief Letter Journal is a quiet, private place to write unsent letters to a parent, partner, child, sibling, friend or pet you have lost. Each letter opens with "Dear [name]", saves itself as you type, and stays only on your phone.

The app has no internet permission, so it cannot send your letters anywhere. There is no account, no cloud, no tracking and no AI.

Write in your own time - Add the person you miss, with their relation and, if you like, their birthday and the date they died. - Add a photo if you want. It is cropped in a circle and stored encrypted, with location and camera details removed. - A plain, calm editor that saves on its own. - Gentle, optional prompts for each relation. Pets have their own prompts. - No streaks, no counters, no nagging. Come back whenever you want.

End each letter your way - Keep: it stays in your journal and you can keep writing. - Seal: it becomes read-only. You can unseal it later. - Release: let it go. It is deleted for good after you confirm.

Private by design - Everything is stored in an encrypted database. The key is protected by your phone's secure hardware. - Optional app lock with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. While it is on, screenshots and the recent-apps preview are blocked. - Reminders for birthdays and anniversaries are off by default. When on, the notification only says "A moment for you", never a name or a date, and it is hidden on the lock screen. - The home screen widget never shows letter text. With app lock on it only shows a plain "Write" button. - Encrypted backups protected by a passphrase you choose, saved wherever you pick. Restore them on a new phone.

What is included - Available from the start: one person, basic prompts, reminders, app lock, and encrypted backup and restore. - Needs the one-time unlock in the app: more than one person, all prompts, and PDF export of one letter or all letters to one person. It is not a subscription.

The purchase is checked by the Google Play Store app. Grief Letter Journal itself still has no internet permission.

This app is not a replacement for professional support. If you are struggling, please reach out to someone you trust or a local support service.

## Questions and answers

### What does Grief Letter Journal do?

You write unsent letters to a person or pet you lost. Each letter opens with "Dear" and the name, saves itself as you type, and ends as Keep, Seal or Release. It also has optional prompts, birthday and anniversary reminders, and a home screen widget.

### What does it not do?

It has no account, cloud sync, ads, tracking or AI, and no streaks or counters. It does not replace professional support.

### Where are my letters stored?

Only on your phone, in an encrypted database. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot send them anywhere. You can make an encrypted backup with a passphrase you choose and restore it on a new phone.

### Can someone else read my letters on my phone?

You can turn on an app lock with fingerprint, face or device PIN. While it is on, screenshots and the recent-apps preview are blocked. Reminders show only "A moment for you", and the widget never shows letter text.

### What is free and what needs a purchase?

One person, basic prompts, reminders, app lock, and encrypted backup and restore are free. More than one person, all prompts and PDF export need a one-time purchase in the app. It is not a subscription.

### Which Android versions does it run on?

Android 11 or newer.

# Health Reports: BP & Sleep PDF

> Turn Health Connect blood pressure, heart rate and sleep into a PDF report.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.healthconnectpdfreports&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/privacy/
- Health & Fitness
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/es/index.md

## About

Health Reports turns the blood pressure, heart rate and sleep data in Health Connect into one clean PDF that you can bring to a doctor's visit.

Pick a date range of 7, 30 or 90 days, or choose your own dates. The report starts with a summary page, then lists the details:

- Summary: average, lowest and highest blood pressure and heart rate, resting heart rate trend, average sleep length and how many readings fall in each blood pressure category. - Blood pressure: a table of every reading with time, source app and its AHA category in neutral wording. - Heart rate: daily resting, lowest and highest values with a trend chart. - Sleep: a nightly table with total time and sleep stages, plus a stage summary.

Other features:

- Preview every page before you share it. - Share the PDF by email or message, or print it, through the normal Android share sheet and print dialog. - Add a blood pressure reading by hand, with pulse if you like. It is saved to Health Connect. - Duplicate readings from different apps are merged. You can choose a preferred source app for each metric. - Add your name to the report if you want. No date of birth is needed. The name is only saved if you ask for it, and it is encrypted on your phone. - A home screen widget shows your last blood pressure reading and your 7-day average resting heart rate. - Light and dark theme follow your system. Works on phones and tablets.

Privacy:

The app has no internet permission, no account and no analytics. It does not keep a copy of your health data. Health Connect stays the only place where the data lives. The temporary PDF is deleted when you leave the preview. The report goes only where you choose to send it.

Purchase:

Your first export is available without payment. After that, sharing and printing more reports needs a one-time in-app purchase called Unlimited reports. Viewing your data, previewing reports, adding readings and the widget do not need a purchase. You can restore the purchase in Settings.

Requirements:

Android 9 or newer. Android 14 and newer include Health Connect. On Android 9 to 13, install the Health Connect app from Google Play. You also need an app or device that writes blood pressure, heart rate or sleep to Health Connect, or you can add blood pressure readings by hand.

Important: Health Reports shows recorded values only. It gives no diagnosis and no medical advice. Talk to your doctor about what your readings mean.

## Guides

- [Average Blood Pressure Calculator for Home Readings](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/average-blood-pressure-calculator/index.md): Average your home blood pressure readings, see the lowest, highest and AHA category, and learn the formula with a worked example.
- [Blood Pressure Categories Chart (AHA, mmHg)](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/blood-pressure-categories-chart/index.md): AHA blood pressure chart with the five categories, the exact mmHg limits, how "or" rules work, and worked examples for home readings.
- [How to Make a Blood Pressure PDF from Health Connect](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/health-connect-blood-pressure-pdf/index.md): Step-by-step: turn blood pressure, heart rate and sleep stored in Android Health Connect into a PDF report you can share or print for your doctor.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do, and what does it not do?

It reads blood pressure, heart rate and sleep from Health Connect and builds a PDF report with a summary page and detail pages. It shows recorded values only and gives no diagnosis and no medical advice.

### Where does my data stay?

The app has no internet permission, no account and no analytics. It keeps no copy of your health data, so Health Connect stays the only place the data lives. The temporary PDF is deleted when you leave the preview and goes only where you send it.

### Do I have to pay?

The first export is free. More exports need a one-time in-app purchase called Unlimited reports, which you can restore in Settings. Viewing data, previews, adding readings by hand and the widget need no purchase.

### Which Android versions work?

Android 9 and newer. Android 14 and newer include Health Connect. On Android 9 to 13, install the Health Connect app from Google Play.

### Do I need a blood pressure cuff or a watch?

You need an app or device that writes blood pressure, heart rate or sleep to Health Connect. You can also add blood pressure readings by hand in the app, and they are saved to Health Connect.

### How far back can a report go?

Choose 7, 30 or 90 days, or your own dates. For ranges longer than 30 days, Health Connect asks you to allow access to history.

# Hipoteca: Mortgage Calculator

> Plan, compare and track a Spanish mortgage: costs, taxes and Euríbor risk.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.morgagecalc&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/privacy/
- Finance
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/es/index.md

## About

Hipoteca helps you decide on and follow a home mortgage in Spain. Start with a plain question, see the real numbers, and keep track of the loan you already pay.

## Features

### How much can i buy?

Enter your net monthly income, other debts, savings, region and residency. The app shows the highest price you can reach, the loan and the monthly payment, and tells you whether your savings or your income is what limits you.

### Fixed, variable or mixed?

See a fixed, a variable and a mixed offer side by side: payment now, payment in year 6, worst-case payment, median total interest, and the Euríbor level at which variable stops beating fixed.

### What a loan really costs

Save your own offers with price, savings, region, new build or resale, term, rate type, age and residency. The result shows the monthly payment, TIN and TAE, principal versus interest, and the money you need on day one: down payment, ITP or IVA plus AJD, notary, registry, gestoría and appraisal. It also checks whether the linked products the bank asks for (salary, home insurance, life insurance) pay for themselves.

### Purchase taxes by region

Tax rules for each Spanish region are built in, including young-buyer rates. Regions whose data has not yet been confirmed against two sources are clearly flagged.

### What if euríbor rises?

Run best, base and worst Euríbor scenarios, or 1,000 random futures with a fan chart, payment ranges and the share of futures in which you would pay more than today.

### Pay off early

Try a one-off or yearly extra payment and compare shortening the term with lowering the payment, after the legal early-repayment fee.

### Track the mortgage you have

Enter when you signed, the amount, term and rate. See what you owe today, how much is paid, when it ends, what is still to pay, and the jump when a mixed loan turns variable. Enter your bank's balance to make it exact. A home screen widget shows what you owe, your payment and the end date.

### Schedule and export

Yearly table and balance chart. Share the schedule as PDF or as CSV that opens correctly in Spanish spreadsheets.

### Private by design

No account and no sign-in. Your mortgage data stays on your phone. The app shows a small ad banner on some screens; a one-time purchase removes it.

Good to know

- Built for Spain only, in euros.
- Euríbor is not downloaded. The app ships with a recent value you can change in Settings.
- Available in English, Spanish and German.
- Results are estimates and do not replace an offer or advice from your bank.

## Screenshots

## Guides

- [Mortgage Monthly Payment Formula With Example](https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/mortgage-monthly-payment-formula/index.md): How a fixed-rate mortgage payment is calculated, with a worked example for 200,000 euros at 2.60 % over 30 years, and a calculator you can try.
- [Spain Mortgage Early Repayment Fee: Legal Caps](https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/spain-mortgage-early-repayment-fee/index.md): Maximum early repayment fee on a Spanish mortgage under Ley 5/2019, by rate type and year, with a worked example and how to compare your options.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It calculates how much home you can afford, compares fixed, variable and mixed mortgages, shows the full cost with regional purchase taxes, and simulates Euríbor rises and early repayments. It also tracks a mortgage you already pay, with a home screen widget.

### What does it not do?

It works for Spain only, in euros. It does not download Euríbor (it ships with a value you can change in Settings) and it does not contact banks. Results are estimates and do not replace an offer or advice from your bank.

### Where is my data stored?

Your mortgages stay on your phone. There is no account and no sign-in. The app uses the network only for ads and the in-app purchase.

### Is anything paid?

All features are free. The app shows a small ad banner on the Result and Compare screens, and a one-time in-app purchase removes it.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 9 and later. The language picker inside the app (English, Spanish, German) needs Android 13 or later.

# Hive Log: Beekeeping Journal

> Log hive inspections, treatments and feedings, track varroa, set reminders.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.beekeepinghivelog&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/privacy/
- Productivity
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/es/index.md

## About

Beekeeping Hive Log is a simple inspection log for backyard beekeepers. It works without an account and keeps all your data on your device.

## Features

### Fast inspections, even with gloves

- Large buttons for queen seen, eggs, brood pattern and temperament
- Optional varroa count with a minus and plus stepper
- Answers from the last inspection are filled in, so a routine check takes a few taps

### Everything per hive

- One timeline per hive with inspections, treatments and feedings
- Varroa trend chart with a guideline line at 3 mites per day, plus a text summary and a table view
- Hive status at a glance: OK, needs attention, or in a withdrawal period
- Archive hives you no longer keep without losing their history

### Treatments and feeding

- Log treatments with a withdrawal period. The app shows a warning until it ends and can remind you on the end date. It never blocks you.
- Log feedings: syrup 1:1, syrup 2:1, fondant or pollen patty
- Metric or imperial units

### Reminders

- One-off reminders or repeats every N days
- Notifications at a time you choose, 08:00 by default
- Home screen widget with your next reminders and the hives that need attention

### Your data stays on your device

- The app has no internet permission and sends nothing anywhere
- No account, no analytics
- Backup and restore to a file you pick. The backup is plain JSON and not encrypted, so keep it somewhere private.

### For every screen

- Phones and tablets, with a list and detail view side by side on larger screens
- Light and dark theme follow your system setting
- Screen reader labels, large touch targets and high-contrast support

### Free and pro

Included without purchase: up to 3 active hives, all logging, reminders, the widget and backup. Archived hives do not count towards the 3. Pro is a single purchase through Google Play, not a subscription. It unlocks unlimited hives and CSV and PDF export that you can share with a vet or inspector.

The varroa guideline line is a display hint, not treatment advice. Follow local regulations and product labels for treatments and withdrawal periods.

## Guides

- [Bee Syrup Ratio 1:1 and 2:1 Chart and Converter](https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/bee-syrup-ratio-1-1-and-2-1/index.md): Sugar and water amounts for 1:1 and 2:1 bee syrup, with a chart, worked examples and metric to imperial conversions.
- [Bee Treatment Withdrawal Period Calculator](https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/bee-treatment-withdrawal-period-calculator/index.md): Work out when a hive treatment withdrawal period ends. Formula, three worked examples, a quick table and a calculator.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It logs inspections, treatments and feedings for each hive on one timeline, and charts varroa counts. It also sets one-off or repeating reminders and has a home screen widget.

### What does it not do?

It has no accounts, cloud sync, photos, harvest logging or multiple apiaries. It does not give treatment advice, and the varroa line at 3 mites per day is only a display hint.

### Where is my data stored?

Only on your device. The app has no internet permission, no account and no analytics. Backup and restore use a plain JSON file you pick, which is not encrypted, so keep it somewhere private.

### What is free and what needs a purchase?

Up to 3 active hives, all logging, reminders, the widget and backup are free, and archived hives do not count. Pro is a single purchase through Google Play, not a subscription, and adds unlimited hives and CSV and PDF export.

### Does it block me during a withdrawal period?

No. It shows a warning until the withdrawal ends and can offer a reminder for the end date, but you can always save.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer, on phones and tablets.

Keep every horse's care in one place, on your phone, with no account and no internet.

# Job Loss Plan: 12-Week Guide

> Laid off? A calm 12-week checklist with deadlines, budget and runway math.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/job-loss-12-week-plan/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.jobloss12weekplan&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/job-loss-12-week-plan/privacy/
- Productivity
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/job-loss-12-week-plan/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/job-loss-12-week-plan/es/index.md

## About

Just lost your job? Take it one week at a time.

Job Loss Plan gives you a clear 12-week plan for the weeks after a layoff in the US. Each week has a short checklist that covers severance, benefits, your budget, job applications and rest. A quick weekly check-in helps you see how you are doing.

There is no account to create. Everything you enter stays on your phone.

## Features

### What you get

- A plan for every week. "This week" shows what matters now. The overview shows all 12 weeks and your progress.
- Tasks you control. Edit, add, delete and reorder tasks, or restore the default tasks for a week.
- Key deadlines worked out from your layoff date: unemployment filing, final pay, 401(k) rollover review, end of health coverage and the COBRA election window. You can change any date to match your paperwork.
- Reminders before each deadline and a weekly review reminder. Notifications never show amounts.
- A simple monthly budget. Mark each cost as essential or cuttable and see ideas for what to trim.
- Runway calculator. See how many weeks your savings, severance and unemployment benefit can cover, and how much longer if you cut back.
- Weekly review. Rate your rest and mood from 1 to 5, add a note and watch the trend.
- Application counter with an optional weekly target. It is a simple count, not a job tracker.
- After week 12, add 4 more weeks or start a new plan. Old plans are kept read-only.
- Home screen widget with the current week, open tasks, next deadline and runway.
- Backup and restore. Export your data to a file you choose and import it again later.

### Privacy

- The app does not use the internet. It has no analytics and no tracking.
- Optional app lock with your fingerprint or screen lock. While it is on, screenshots of money screens are blocked and the widget hides your runway.
- Your data is not included in cloud backups. Backup files are plain text, so keep them somewhere private.

### Phones and tablets

Light and dark mode follow your system. Touch targets are large and screen reader labels are included. On tablets, the plan and the budget use side-by-side views.

### Plan pro

Plan Pro is a one-time purchase in the app. It adds a PDF export of your plan, budget and reviews, and three extra plan templates: Career switch, Freelance bridge and Relocation. The plan, deadlines, budget, runway, reviews, reminders, widget and backup do not need a purchase.

### Important

Job Loss Plan offers general US information only. It is not legal or financial advice. Rules differ by state, so check official sources such as the U.S. Department of Labor and HealthCare.gov for your situation.

## Questions and answers

It gives you a 12-week plan for the weeks after a layoff in the US, with a weekly checklist, deadlines worked out from your layoff date, a monthly budget, a runway calculator and a weekly review. You can edit, add, delete and reorder tasks.

### What does it not do?

It is not a job tracker, it has no job search and it gives no legal or financial advice. It covers general US rules only and has no state-specific rules.

On your phone only. There is no account, no ads, no analytics and no internet access. Your data is not included in cloud backups, and you can export it to a file you choose.

The plan, deadlines, budget, runway, reviews, reminders, widget and backup are free. Plan Pro is a one-time purchase in the app that adds a PDF export and three extra plan templates: Career switch, Freelance bridge and Relocation.

Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer, on phones and tablets.

Yes, with an optional app lock using your fingerprint or screen lock. While it is on, screenshots of money screens are blocked and the widget hides your runway. Notifications never show amounts.

# Metronome & Practice Log

> Metronome that logs your practice time automatically and tracks your streak

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/metronome-and-practice-log/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.metronomeandpracticelog&hl=en

- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/metronome-and-practice-log/es/index.md

## About

Press play and practise. Metronome & Practice Log keeps time and writes your practice diary for you.

## Features

### A metronome you can rely on

- Tempo from 30 to 300 BPM with large minus and plus buttons, a slider and tap tempo
- Time signatures 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4 and 6/8, with accents you set for each beat
- Three sounds: click, wood and beep
- Screen flash and vibration on the beat, with one simple switch for both
- Steady timing in the background and with the screen off, with a notification to pause

### Practice logging without extra taps

- A session starts when you press play and ends when you pause
- Sessions shorter than 30 seconds are ignored
- Assign a piece, or log to "General"
- Each session saves its time signature, your last tempo and the time-weighted average tempo
- Edit or delete any session, with undo
- Add, rename and delete your pieces

### See your progress

- Daily streak: every day with at least one minute of practice counts
- Bar chart of your last 7 days

### Pro (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)

These features need the Pro purchase:

The metronome, automatic logging, streaks and the 7-day chart work without it.

- Export your log as CSV or JSON to a file you choose
- Full graphs: 12 weeks of practice time and tempo progress for each piece
- Accent colour themes
- Home-screen widget with your streak, today's time and the last 7 days

### Your data stays on your device

- The app has no internet permission
- No account, no analytics, no crash reporting
- No cloud backup of your practice data. It stays on this device unless you export it.

### Made to be easy to use

Contact: apps@schimpf.es

- Follows your system light or dark mode
- Works with TalkBack: controls are labelled, the tempo is one adjustable control, and charts have a spoken summary
- Large touch targets for quick use on a music stand
- Phone and tablet layouts. On tablets, the metronome and your log sit side by side.

### What does the app do?

It is a metronome from 30 to 300 BPM with tap tempo, time signatures 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4 and 6/8, and three sounds. It also logs your practice automatically and counts a daily streak.

### How does it log my practice?

A session starts when you press play and ends when you pause. Sessions under 30 seconds are ignored, and each one saves its piece, time signature, last tempo and time-weighted average tempo. You can edit or delete any session.

### Where is my data stored?

On your device only. The app has no internet permission, no account, no analytics and no cloud backup, and your data leaves the device only if you export it.

### What needs the Pro purchase?

Export as CSV or JSON, the full graphs (12 weeks and tempo progress per piece), accent colour themes and the home-screen widget. The metronome, automatic logging, streaks and the 7-day chart are free.

### Does it keep time with the screen off?

Yes. It keeps steady time in the background and with the screen off, and a notification lets you pause it.

### Which Android versions does it support?

Android 8.0 or newer, on phones and tablets.

# Minijob Calculator Germany

> German Minijob limit, hours and employer cost 2026/2027. No account.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-german-minijob-calculator/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.offlinegermanminijobcalculator&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-german-minijob-calculator/privacy/
- Finance
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-german-minijob-calculator/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-german-minijob-calculator/es/index.md

## About

How much can I earn in my Minijob? How many hours can I work? What does it cost my employer? Minijob Calculator answers these questions with the German rules for 2026 and 2027, fully offline.

Worker calculator • 2026 earnings limit: 603 € a month, 7,236 € a year (2027 provisional: 633 € a month) • Enter your hourly wage and either hours or earnings per month; the other value is worked out for you • Maximum hours at your hourly wage • Pension share (3.6% with a commercial employer, 13.6% in a private household) and your net pay • See what changes if you opt out of pension insurance • Warnings when the wage is below the minimum wage or earnings move into the Midijob range

Employer cost • Commercial employer or private household (Haushaltsscheck) • Every levy on its own line: pension, health, flat-rate tax, U1, U2, insolvency levy and accident insurance • Total monthly cost of the Minijob

Hours log • Shifts with date, start, end and break, overnight shifts included • Money and hours left this month, updated as you add shifts • Warning before a shift breaks the monthly or yearly limit • Wage changes over time are applied to the right shifts

Year overview • Year total against the yearly limit, month by month • Mark up to 2 occasional overruns per year, as the rules allow

Widget • Money left this month and this year on your home screen; tap it to open the hours log

Your data stays with you • No internet permission, no account, no ads, no tracking • Your data is not in Google cloud backup; it moves to a new phone only by device-to-device transfer • Light and dark theme, German and English, phone and tablet layouts, screen reader support

Note: all results are estimates, not tax or legal advice. The 2027 values are provisional until officially confirmed and are updated through app releases.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app calculate?

It works out your Minijob earnings limit, the maximum hours at your hourly wage, your pension share and net pay, and the full employer cost. It also logs shifts and tracks the yearly limit, using the 2026 and 2027 rules chosen by the shift date.

### What does the app not do?

It does not track several jobs or employers, calculate a full Midijob, or create payslips or payroll filings. It only warns when you have several Minijobs or your earnings move into the Midijob range.

### Where is my data stored?

Everything stays on your phone. The app has no internet permission, no account, no ads and no tracking, and your data is not in Google cloud backup. It moves to a new phone only by device-to-device transfer.

### Does anything need a purchase?

The current version is free and everything in it works without paying. PDF and CSV export is planned for later as a one-time purchase and is not in this version.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 10 (API 29) and newer, on phones and tablets. It follows the system light or dark theme and has German and English text.

### Are the 2027 values final?

No. The 2027 values are provisional until officially confirmed. The app updates them through app releases, and all results are estimates, not tax or legal advice.
