- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/numeric-ibs-symptom-scorer/es/index.md

## About

Numeric IBS Symptom Scorer is a private diary for people with irritable bowel syndrome, or suspected IBS, who want clear numbers to track their symptoms for themselves or for their doctor.

Exact numbers, no sliders Rate abdominal pain, bloating, gas, cramping and nausea from 0 to 10 by tapping a number or typing it. Add up to five symptoms of your own. Log as many entries per day as you like, each with an optional note. Leave a symptom unrated if you did not notice it.

A proper bowel log Record each bowel movement with the Bristol stool type (drawn icons plus text), urgency from 0 to 10, complete or incomplete emptying, an optional blood or mucus flag and a note.

Food log with tags Write down what you ate and add your own reusable tags, such as dairy, onion or coffee.

Today view and charts See the whole day in time order and edit or delete any entry. Charts show the daily average and maximum per symptom, bowel movements per day and your Bristol type distribution over 7, 30 or 90 days or all time, with no history limit. Every chart also has a written summary.

Widget and reminder The home screen widget shows today's latest scores and bowel count, with quick-add buttons. An optional daily reminder helps you keep the habit.

Private by design No account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics. The app has no internet permission. Your diary is stored in an encrypted database on your phone. An optional app lock uses your fingerprint, face, screen lock or an app PIN, and while it is on, the app is hidden in the recent apps view.

Pro, a one-time purchase • Trigger report: your average score a few hours after each food tag, compared with your usual level, with the number of meals behind it. • Export a PDF report for your doctor or CSV files for any date range. • Encrypted, password-protected backup and restore, saved wherever you choose. Logging, charts, the widget, the reminder and the app lock stay free.

Light and dark theme, phone and tablet layouts, and full screen reader support.

This app is not medical advice and does not diagnose anything. Food links it shows are possible links only. Talk to your doctor about your symptoms.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It is a diary where you rate abdominal pain, bloating, gas, cramping and nausea from 0 to 10 by tapping or typing a number, plus up to five symptoms of your own. You also log bowel movements (Bristol type 1 to 7, urgency 0 to 10) and food with tags, and see charts over 7, 30 or 90 days or all time.

### Does it diagnose IBS or tell me which foods to avoid?

No. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose anything. The trigger report shows your average score after each food tag compared with your usual level, and labels results as possible links only.

### Where is my data stored?

On your phone, in an encrypted database. There is no account, no cloud, no ads and no analytics, and the app has no internet permission. Android auto-backup is turned off, so your diary only leaves the phone if you export it or save an encrypted backup.

### What needs Pro?

Pro is a one-time purchase through Google Play. It adds the trigger report, PDF and CSV export and password-protected backup and restore. Logging, the timeline, all charts, the widget, the reminder and the app lock are free.

### Which Android versions does it support?

Android 11 or newer. It has phone and tablet layouts, a light and dark theme and screen reader support.

### Is the app available in my language?

Not yet. The app itself is English only, and the Play Store page is also available in German and Spanish.

# Paint Calc: Room Paint Amount

> Work out how much paint a room needs, with coats, doors and waste

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.offlinepaintcoveragecalc&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/privacy/
- House &Amp; Home
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/es/index.md

## About

Paint Calc works out how much paint a room needs and rounds the result up to cans you can actually buy. It runs on your device with no account and no sign-in, so you can use it on site, in the shop or in a basement with no signal.

## Features

### Quick or wall by wall

- Quick mode: enter length, width and height and the wall area is worked out for you.
- Per-wall mode: add walls one by one for odd-shaped rooms, stairwells and attic rooms.
- Take off doors and windows with one tap using standard sizes, or enter custom sizes.

### Every surface, your way

- Walls, ceiling, trim and primer, each with its own on/off switch, coats (1 to 4) and coverage.
- Type the coverage printed on the can, in sq ft per gallon or m2 per litre.
- Smooth, light or heavy texture adds 0, 10 or 20 percent more paint.
- Waste slider from 0 to 25 percent.

### Answers in cans, not decimals

- Imperial: gallons and quarts. When three quarts would cost more than a gallon, you get the gallon.
- Metric: 5 L, 2.5 L, 1 L and 0.5 L tins.
- See the total and the breakdown for each surface.

### Save and share

- Save as many rooms as you like.
- Share a room result as plain text with any app.
- A home screen widget shows the paint for the last room or project you opened.

### Pro (ONE IN-APP PURCHASE)

The features above are included in the base app. These features need the Pro purchase, made through Google Play:

- Projects: group rooms and get totals per surface and per paint. Paint is pooled by product, so you can buy fewer cans than room by room.
- Cost estimate: save your paint prices per can size and see the cost of each project in your currency.
- PDF quotes: your business name, the client, the rooms, paint amounts, paint cost and an optional labor line. Share the PDF from your phone.
- Share whole projects as text.

### Phones and tablets

- Two-pane layout on tablets and foldables.
- Light and dark theme follow your system setting.
- Screen reader labels on controls and large touch targets.

### Your data stays on your device

Paint Calc does not request the internet permission. Your rooms, projects and client names are stored only on this device and are excluded from cloud backup. The only connection is Google Play, for the optional Pro purchase.

Results are estimates. Always check the coverage printed on your paint can.

- [Room editor](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/screen-2.png)
- [Room list](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/screen-3.png)

- [How Much Paint for a 12x12 Room? Gallons by Room Size](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/how-much-paint-for-a-12x12-room/index.md): A 12x12 room with 8 ft walls needs about 2 gallons and 1 quart for two coats. Table of paint by room size, with the numbers behind it.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app calculate?

It works out how much paint a room needs from its size, doors and windows, coats, coverage, texture and waste. It rounds the result up to cans you can buy: gallons and quarts, or 5 L, 2.5 L, 1 L and 0.5 L tins.

### What does the app not do?

It does not match or mix colors, measure with the camera, look up store prices or hold a paint brand database. You type the coverage printed on your can.

### Does it need an account or internet?

No. There is no account or sign-in, and the app does not request the internet permission, so it works with no signal.

### Where is my data stored?

Rooms, projects and client names stay on your device only and are excluded from cloud backup. The only connection is Google Play, for the optional Pro purchase.

### What is free and what needs a purchase?

Room calculations, saving rooms, sharing results as text and the home screen widget are free. Projects, cost estimates, PDF quotes and sharing whole projects need the Pro in-app purchase through Google Play.

### Which Android versions does it support?

Android 10 or newer. It has a two-pane layout on tablets and foldables.

# PDF Reader & Scanner

> Read, search, scan and sign PDFs on your phone.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.offlinepdfreaderandscanner&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/privacy/
- Productivity
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/es/index.md

## About

A fast, private PDF reader and document scanner. It works without a connection, shows no ads and has no internet permission, so your files never leave your phone unless you share or export them.

## Features

### Read pdfs

- Open PDFs from your phone, cloud apps or "Open with". No access to all your files needed.
- Smooth vertical scrolling at full width, on phones and tablets.
- Picks up at the page where you stopped.
- Table of contents for PDFs that have one.
- Search text in PDFs that already have a text layer.
- Night pages: invert page colours for reading in the dark. The app itself follows your light or dark system setting.
- Password-protected PDFs on Android 15 and newer.
- Recent files list that you can clear at any time.

### Scan documents

- Edge detection and cropping with the Google ML Kit document scanner.
- Unlimited scans, no watermark.
- Scans are saved as PDF in a private library on your phone.
- Search, sort and rename your scans, with page thumbnails.
- Add and delete pages of a saved scan.
- Export to any folder or share as PDF.

### Pro: one-time purchase

- Searchable scans: text recognition runs on your phone after every scan, and works on image-only PDFs too.
- Highlight text with standard PDF highlights that other readers show.
- Sign documents with a drawn signature. Your signature is encrypted with a key that never leaves the phone.
- Edits are saved as a copy in your library. Your original file is never changed.
- No subscription, no trial, no account.

### Private by design

- No internet permission. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is tracked.
- No account, no analytics.
- The library is excluded from backups.
- No ads.

### Home screen widget

Your last three scans or opened PDFs and a one-tap Scan button.

Available in English, German and Spanish.

Scanning and Pro need Google Play services. Reading works without them. Text recognition supports the Latin alphabet.

## Guides

- [How to Make a Scanned PDF Searchable on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/make-scanned-pdf-searchable/index.md): Why a scanned PDF cannot be searched, how OCR adds a hidden text layer, and how to turn a scan into a searchable PDF on your phone.
- [Open a Password-Protected PDF on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/open-password-protected-pdf-on-android/index.md): Why a PDF asks for a password, which Android versions can open it, what to do when it fails, and the difference between the two PDF passwords.

## Questions and answers

### Does the app work offline?

Yes. The app has no internet permission, so reading, scanning and text recognition all run on your phone.

### Where are my files stored?

Scans and edited copies stay in a private library on your phone, which is excluded from Android backups. A file leaves the phone only when you share or export it.

### What can I do for free?

Reading, search in PDFs that already have text, unlimited scanning without a watermark, a library with search and sort, page editing, export and share.

### What needs the Pro purchase?

Making scans searchable (OCR), highlighting text and signing with a drawn signature. Pro is a one-time purchase through Google Play, with no subscription or account.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 8.0 and newer. Password-protected PDFs open on Android 15 and newer, and older versions show a message instead.

### Does it change my original PDF?

No. Highlights, signatures and text recognition on an imported PDF are saved as a copy in your library. Scans from the app are replaced by their searchable version.

# Plumber Invoice & Quote Maker

> Plumbing quotes, signatures, invoices and payments for plumbers

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/
- Coming soon to Google Play
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/privacy/
- Business
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/es/index.md

## About

Plumber Invoice is a quote and invoice app for solo plumbers. You write the quote at the job, the customer signs with a finger, and one tap turns it into an invoice. Everything works without signal, so basements and crawlspaces are no problem.

## Features

### Quotes

Add lines from the built-in price book or type your own. The price book has about 120 common plumbing items in eight categories: pipe, fittings, valves, water heaters, fixtures, drains, gas and labor. Items come without prices. You enter your cost and markup once, and the app reuses them on every plumbing quote. Set the sales tax and the deposit percentage on each quote. Buttons and quantity steppers are large, so you can use them with gloves on. Every change saves on the device as you type, and each edit screen shows "Saved on device".

### Signature

The customer signs on a full-screen pad in portrait or landscape. The signer name and the time go on the quote. A signed quote is locked until you clear the signature.

### Invoices and payments

Create the invoice from a signed quote with one tap. The quote lines are copied over. Record cash, check or other payments with date and reference, including the deposit, and the invoice shows the balance due. The app blocks a payment larger than the balance. Quotes are numbered Q-0001, invoices INV-0001. You can change both prefixes.

### Pdf and sending

The app builds the PDF on your phone. Send it by SMS, WhatsApp, email or any app in the Android share sheet. With no signal, the document waits in the Outbox, and a notification tells you when signal is back. You tap Send yourself.

### Your data

There is no account and no server. The app has no internet permission. The database, photos and signatures are encrypted on the device. You can turn on an app lock with fingerprint, face or device PIN. Backups are encrypted with a passphrase you choose and go to a file or Google Drive. If you lose the passphrase, the backup cannot be opened.

### Phone, tablet and widget

Phones and tablets have their own layouts. The theme follows your system setting. The home screen widget shows your open balance and the number of unpaid invoices, with a New quote button. It hides amounts while the app lock is on.

### Free and pro

Free: unlimited jobs, quotes and invoices. PDFs carry a watermark. Pro is a one-time purchase in Google Play. It adds your logo, the customer's signature image and job photos to the PDF, and removes the watermark. There is no subscription.

Made for US plumbers: US dollars and one combined sales tax rate per document. Check your state's rules for what an invoice must show, such as your contractor license number. This plumber invoice app does not send anything over the internet by itself.

## Screenshots

- [Quote with lines](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/screen-1.png)
- [Jobs list](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/screen-2.png)
- [Price book](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/screen-3.png)
- [Customers](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/screen-4.png)
- [Settings](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/screen-5.png)

## Guides

- [Plumbing Markup Calculator and Formula](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/plumbing-markup-calculator/index.md): Work out the sell price of pipe, fittings and parts from your cost and markup %, and see the margin it gives. Formula, worked example and table.
- [Plumbing Quote: Sales Tax and Deposit Math](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/plumbing-quote-sales-tax-and-deposit/index.md): How to add sales tax to taxable lines only, set a deposit % on the total and find the balance due on a plumbing quote. Worked example and calculator.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

It makes plumbing quotes and invoices on your phone or tablet. The customer signs the quote with a finger, one tap turns it into an invoice, and you record payments and send the PDF by SMS, WhatsApp or email.

### Does it work without signal?

Yes. Quotes, signatures, invoices and PDFs all work offline. A document you cannot send yet waits in the Outbox, and you get a notification when signal is back.

### Where is my data stored?

Only on your device, encrypted. There is no account and no server, and the app has no internet permission. Backups are encrypted with a passphrase you choose and go to a file or Google Drive, and a lost passphrase cannot be recovered.

### What does the app not do?

It does not take card payments, sync between devices or support crews. It also has no accounting links, no VAT and no other currencies than US dollars.

### Do I have to pay for anything?

Jobs, quotes and invoices are unlimited for free, but PDFs carry a watermark. A one-time Pro purchase in Google Play adds your logo, the customer's signature image and job photos to the PDF and removes the watermark. There is no subscription.

### Which Android versions does it run on?

Android 10 and newer, on phones and tablets. The app is in English and made for US plumbers.

# Steak Doneness Chart & Timer

> Pull temps for steak, pork, chicken, lamb and fish, with a rest and flip timer.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-steak-doneness-chart/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.offlinesteakdonenesschart&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-steak-doneness-chart/privacy/
- Food & Drink
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-steak-doneness-chart/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-steak-doneness-chart/es/index.md

## About

Know exactly when to take your meat off the heat.

Pick the meat, the cut and how you like it done. You get three numbers in big type:

- Pull temp: when to take it off the heat - Final temp: where it ends up after carryover - Rest time: how long to let it sit before slicing

Then tap one button to start the rest timer.

## Features

### Safety warnings

Chef-style temps, such as a medium rare burger or a juicy chicken breast, can be below the USDA safe minimum. The app still shows them, but marks them with a clear warning and shows the USDA minimum next to them.

### Make it yours

Like your ribeye a little rarer? Edit the temps for any built-in cut. Add your own cuts, like picanha or pulled pork shoulder. Reset any edit to the default with one tap. Custom temps get the same USDA warning.

### One simple timer

Rest presets from 3 to 20 minutes and flip presets from 1 to 4 minutes. An alarm sounds when it ends, and the screen stays on while it counts down. Leaving the app? Tap Set in Clock app and your phone's Clock app takes over the countdown.

### Home-screen widget

Your last lookup stays on your home screen: cut, doneness, pull temp and final temp. Tap it to jump back in.

### Built for the grill

- Big text and large buttons for greasy fingers
- °F or °C, remembered
- Light and dark theme that follows your phone
- Phone and tablet layouts; on tablets the chart and timer sit side by side
- Screen reader support

### Privacy

- The app has no internet permission, so it cannot go online
- No account, no tracking, no analytics
- Your custom temps are included in your Android backup. Nothing else leaves the device.

### Purchase

The app is a paid download. All features are included after purchase. There are no in-app purchases.

Covers beef, pork, chicken, lamb and fish. Safe minimums are based on USDA FSIS. Temperatures are guidance only; always use a calibrated thermometer.

## Guides

- [Carryover Cooking: When to Pull Steak Off the Heat](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-steak-doneness-chart/steak-carryover-cooking-when-to-pull/index.md): How much a steak or roast rises while resting, with a worked example for finding your pull temperature in °F and °C.

## Questions and answers

### What does the app do?

You pick the meat, the cut and the doneness, and it shows the pull temp, the final temp after carryover and the rest time. It covers beef, pork, chicken, lamb and fish, and you can edit any temp or add your own cuts.

### What does the app not do?

It does not connect to Bluetooth thermometers, give cooking times by thickness, list sous-vide temps or include recipes. The timer runs one countdown at a time.

### Does it work without internet, and where does my data stay?

It works fully offline because the app has no internet permission. Your custom temps and settings stay on your phone, and the custom temps are included in your Android backup. There is no account, no ads and no tracking.

### Do I need to buy anything besides the app?

No. The app is a paid download, every feature is included and there are no in-app purchases.

### Which Android versions does it support?

Android 10 and newer, on phones and tablets. On tablets the chart and the timer sit side by side.

### Will the timer alert me if I leave the app?

The timer sounds its alarm only while the app is open. Tap Set in Clock app to hand the countdown to your phone's Clock app, which alerts you with the app closed.

# Storage Analyzer: Big Files

> Find large files, duplicates and old junk, then clear space safely.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.adfreestorageanalyzer&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/privacy/
- Tools
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/es/index.md

## About

See what fills your phone and free up space, fully offline.

Storage Analyzer does not ask for the internet permission, so Android does not let it go online at all. No ads, no analytics, no crash reports, no account, no cloud. Everything it finds stays on your phone. You can check this yourself: the app shows its network permissions, read live from Android, on its privacy screen.

## Features

### What it finds

- Large files, sorted by size, with filters for images, videos, audio, documents, APKs and archives.
- Exact duplicates: files over 1 MB with the same size are compared by SHA-256 checksum, so only true copies are shown. The newest copy is kept by default, and at least one copy is always kept.
- Old files not changed for more than 90 days, grouped into Downloads, Screenshots, WhatsApp media, APK installers and other files.
- Folder sizes as a map you can tap through, with a list view and breadcrumb to go back.
- Space used by each app (app, data and cache), with a shortcut to the app's system settings to clear its cache.

### Safe delete

Deleted files go to the app's Trash first. Undo right away, or restore them from Trash for 7 days. After that they are deleted for good. Files are moved, not copied, so it is fast even for big videos. Folders are never deleted.

### You stay in control

- Scans run only when you tap Scan, never in the background.
- Full mode uses All files access to check every folder on internal storage and SD card.
- Prefer not to grant that? Limited mode only looks at the photos, videos and music Android shares with apps.
- Usage access is only asked for on the Apps screen, and only app sizes are read.

### Also

Note: uninstalling the app also empties its Trash. Restore files you want to keep first.

- Home screen widget with used storage, space you can free and last scan time.
- Light and dark theme from your system setting.
- Phone and tablet layouts.
- Works with screen readers.

## Screenshots

- [Onboarding](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/screen-1.png)
- [Home after scan](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/screen-2.png)
- [Home overview](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/screen-3.png)
- [Large files](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/screen-4.png)
- [Explore](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/screen-5.png)
- [Trash](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/screen-6.png)
- [Settings](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/screen-7.png)

## Guides

- [How to Find Duplicate Files on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/find-duplicate-files-on-android/index.md): How to find exact duplicate files on an Android phone, how checksums prove two files are the same, and which copy to keep when you delete.
- [How to Find Old Unused Files on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/find-old-files-on-android/index.md): Find files you have not changed for more than 90 days: old downloads, screenshots, WhatsApp media and APK installers. See the rules and a worked example.
- [MB to GB Conversion Chart for Phone Storage](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/mb-to-gb-conversion-chart/index.md): Convert MB to GB and back with a chart and a calculator. Learn why a 128 GB phone shows less space, with worked examples for GB and GiB.

## Questions and answers

### Does the app go online or share my data?

No. The app does not request the internet permission, so Android does not let it connect at all. It has no ads, analytics, crash reports or account, and its privacy screen shows the network permissions read live from Android.

### What does the app find, and what does it not do?

It finds large files, exact duplicates (same SHA-256 checksum), files not changed for more than 90 days, folder sizes and the space each app uses. It scans only when you tap Scan, never in the background, and it does not match similar photos or clear the cache of other apps for you.

### Are deleted files gone right away?

No. Deleted files go to the app's Trash, where you can undo or restore them for 7 days before they are deleted for good. Folders are never deleted, and uninstalling the app empties its Trash.

### Do I have to give access to all files?

No. Full mode uses All files access to check every folder on internal storage and the SD card. Limited mode only looks at the photos, videos and music that Android shares with apps.

### Which Android versions does it run on?

Android 10 and newer. Phone and tablet layouts, a light and dark theme and a home screen widget are included.

### Do I have to pay for anything besides the app?

No. The app is a one-time purchase on Google Play, with no subscription, no in-app purchases and no ads. The app is available in English only.

---

# Stutter Practice: DAF

> DAF, paced speech and easy onset practice for people who stutter.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.androidstutterpracticeoffline&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/privacy/
- Health & Fitness
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/es/index.md

## About

Practise fluent speech on your own, anywhere, without an account or an internet connection.

Stutter Practice is a toolkit for adults who stutter. It brings together exercises that many speech therapists use, in one calm, private app.

## Features

### Delayed auditory feedback (DAF)

Hear your own voice a moment later through wired or USB headphones. Set the delay from 25 to 250 ms with a slider, plus and minus buttons or quick presets. A short calibration reads your phone's own audio delay, and you can fine-tune it by ear, so the delay you choose is close to the delay you hear. The app warns you when Bluetooth or the speaker is active, because they add extra delay.

### Paced speech

A visual metronome sets a target rate from 40 to 200 syllables per minute. Practice sentences light up one syllable per beat, with the next sentence shown below. Turn on vibration to feel the beat without looking.

### Easy onset

Start words gently. A live onset meter shows how softly your voice rises and tells you whether the start was gentle or too sudden. 12 exercises go from breath and sighs to full sentences.

### Read aloud

30 English texts at three levels: everyday talk, phone calls, work and stories. Each word is highlighted at your chosen pace. You can combine reading with DAF.

### Practice log and widget

Every session is saved on your phone with its settings. See your streak, today's minutes and a weekly chart. Add the home-screen widget to keep your streak in view.

### Private by design

- No internet permission. Nothing is sent anywhere.
- Your voice is processed live and never recorded or stored.
- No account, no ads, no analytics.
- Your practice log stays on your phone unless you switch on Google backup.

### Free, with a one-time unlock

Free: DAF, paced speech, 3 easy-onset exercises, 3 texts, the full practice log and the widget. One payment unlocks all 12 exercises, all 30 texts and DAF while reading. No subscription.

### Accessible

Light and dark theme follow your system. Works on phones and tablets. Large touch targets and screen reader labels throughout.

Use wired or USB headphones for DAF. Texts are in English.

Stutter Practice is not a medical device and does not replace therapy. It works well alongside guidance from a speech and language therapist.

## Screenshots

- [Onboarding](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/screen-1.png)
- [Home](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/screen-2.png)
- [Paced speech](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/screen-3.png)
- [Practice log](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/screen-4.png)
- [Read aloud](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/screen-5.png)
- [Easy onset](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/screen-6.png)
- [Settings](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/screen-7.png)

## Guides

- [DAF Delay Settings in ms: What to Set and Why](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/daf-delay-settings-ms/index.md): How much delay to set for delayed auditory feedback, why your phone adds its own delay, and a worked example with a calculator.
- [Easy Onset Exercises for Stuttering, Step by Step](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/easy-onset-exercises-stuttering/index.md): How to practice easy onset (gentle voice start) for stuttering, with a six-step exercise ladder and the 120 ms rise-time rule.
- [Syllables Per Minute Chart for Paced Speech](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/syllables-per-minute-chart/index.md): Convert syllables per minute to beat time and sentence time, with a worked example and a small calculator for paced speech practice.

## Questions and answers

### What can I practice with the app?

Delayed auditory feedback (DAF) with a delay from 25 to 250 ms, paced speech with a metronome from 40 to 200 syllables per minute, easy onset with a live onset meter, and read-aloud with 30 English texts. It also keeps a practice log with streaks and a home-screen widget.

### Does it replace speech therapy?

No. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat anything. It works as practice alongside a speech and language therapist.

### Where does my data stay, and is my voice recorded?

Your voice is processed live and never recorded or stored. Sessions, settings and calibration stay on your phone, and the app has no internet permission, no account, no ads and no analytics. The log is only included in Google backup if you switch that on.

### Is the app free, or do I have to buy something?

DAF, paced speech, 3 easy-onset exercises, 3 texts, the full practice log and the widget are free. One one-time purchase unlocks all 12 exercises, all 30 texts and DAF while reading. There is no subscription.

### Which Android versions and headphones does it need?

It runs on Android 8.1 or newer, on phones and tablets. For DAF use wired or USB headphones, because Bluetooth and the phone speaker add extra delay and the app shows a warning when either is active.

### Which language are the exercises in?

The app and its practice texts are in English. The website pages are also available in German and Spanish.

# TDS Section Calc India

> Calculate TDS by section with 1961 and 2025 Act numbers and due dates.

- Android app, Gerrit Schimpf
- Web: https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=es.schimpf.indiaofflinetdssectioncalc&hl=en
- Privacy policy: https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/privacy/
- Finance
- Contact: apps@schimpf.es
- DE: https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/de/index.md
- ES: https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/es/index.md

## About

Work out non-salary TDS in seconds. Pick the payment type, enter the amount and see the TDS, the rate, the net payable and the section, under both numbering systems.

TDS Section Calc covers FY 2025-26 (Income-tax Act 1961) and FY 2026-27 (Income-tax Act 2025). Every result shows the old and new section numbers side by side, so you can move to the new Act without a lookup table.

The app has no internet access. Rates, thresholds and section numbers are bundled with the app and change only with app updates.

## Features

### Included in the free app

PRO FEATURES (one-time purchase through Google Play, not a subscription)

- TDS calculator for non-salary payments: contractors, rent, professional and technical fees, commission, interest, purchase of goods, property and more
- Old and new section numbers on every result and in the rate chart
- Financial year selector: 2025-26 (1961 Act) and 2026-27 (2025 Act)
- Threshold checks per payment, per month (rent) and per financial year, with a note where an aggregate limit applies
- PAN given or not given: the higher no-PAN rate is applied automatically
- Individual/HUF and Others, where the rates differ
- Searchable rate chart with rates, thresholds and notes for each section
- Due-date calendar: monthly deposit dates (7th, and 30 April for March) and quarterly TDS return dates
- Home screen widget with the next TDS due date and the days left
- "Rates as of" date and app version shown with every result
- Light and dark theme that follow your system setting, phone and tablet layouts, screen-reader labels
- Saved payees with PAN, payee type and default section, encrypted on your phone
- Lower or nil deduction certificates with rate, validity and limit. The calculator uses the certificate rate while it is valid and within its limit
- Calculation history per payee, and aggregate threshold checks across the financial year
- Export a working sheet as PDF or Excel (.xlsx) through the share sheet. PAN is masked by default
- Due-date reminders 1 to 7 days ahead
- Interest and late-fee calculator: late deduction, late deposit and late filing fee
- Password-encrypted backup and restore through the file picker
- App lock with fingerprint, face or screen lock

### Your data

Made for small businesses, accountants and CAs, and freelancers who deduct TDS on payments to contractors, landlords, professionals and agents.

Please note: results are estimates and not tax advice. Check the Act, rules and notifications before you deduct, deposit or file. Salary TDS (s.192), TCS, non-resident payments and return filing are not covered.

- No account and no tracking. The app has no internet permission
- Payee data is encrypted on your phone with a key held in the Android Keystore
- The app is excluded from cloud backup. Your data leaves the phone only when you export or back it up
- Reminders and the widget show due dates only, never names or PAN

## Questions and answers

### What does the app calculate?

It calculates non-salary TDS by payment type for FY 2025-26 (Income-tax Act 1961) and FY 2026-27 (Income-tax Act 2025). Each result shows the TDS, the rate, the net payable and the old and new section numbers. Salary TDS (s.192), TCS, non-resident payments and return filing are not covered.

### Does it need an internet connection?

No. The app has no internet permission. Rates, thresholds and section numbers are bundled with the app and change only with app updates.

### Where is my data stored?

On your phone only. There is no account and no tracking. Saved payees are encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore, and the app is excluded from cloud backup. Data leaves the phone only when you export a sheet or create a backup file.

### What is free and what needs a purchase?

The calculator, rate chart, due-date calendar and home screen widget are free, without ads. Pro is a one-time purchase through Google Play, not a subscription. It adds saved payees, certificates, history, PDF and Excel export, reminders, the interest and late-fee calculator, backup and app lock.

### Which Android versions are supported?

Android 8.0 or newer. The layout adapts to phones and tablets, and follows the system light or dark theme.

### Are the results tax advice?

No. The results are estimates. Check the Act, rules and notifications before you deduct, deposit or file.
